<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="zemouregal-vorkath" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Zemouregal &amp; Vorkath</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/FysXlFOwOW.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Zemouregal &amp; Vorkath is a boss encounter consisting of two bosses; Zemouregal and Vorkath. To access this encounter, the players must progress through the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Battle_of_Forinthry <nowiki>Battle of Forinthry</nowiki>]<nowiki>. Completion of the quest unlocks the normal mode and hardmode encounters.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="applicable-damage-boosts-for-vorkath"><nowiki>Applicable Damage boosts for Vorkath</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayer" title="undeadslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayerperk" title="undeadslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> work (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1" alt="dragonslayer" title="dragonslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502927731163170.png?v=1" alt="dragonslayerperk" title="dragonslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> do </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> at time of writing)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Slayer helm boost and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1" alt="genocidal" title="genocidal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> work while on a dragons cluster, blue dragons or undead cluster slayer task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayerperk" title="undeadslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1" alt="genocidal" title="genocidal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be combo'd on the same gizmo</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Salve amulet works</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1" alt="jasdragonbanearrow" title="jasdragonbanearrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Jas dragonbane arrows work</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Lifepoint scaling</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorkath: 750k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> per player (1500k in Hardmode)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Zemouregal: 250k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> per player (500k in Hardmode)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="normal-mode-specifics"><nowiki>Normal Mode specifics</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Every place of power is protected by an undead giant, kill it to disrupt the beam.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Disrupting the places of power disables some of Zemouregal's abilities during the encounter, or starts the encounter.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Northern location: minion spawns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Northwestern location: Zemouregal's Spikes.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Western location: Starts the encounter.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics-hardmode"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics (Hardmode)</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Power meter</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Displays the connection between Zemouregal and Vorkath, affecting damage absorption and damage dealt by Vorkath.
    • Each next phase increases it by net 25%.
    • Empowered zombies can increase it by 50%. 
    • Power meter disappears when vorkath leaves at zero lifepoints.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Dragonfire Breath</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Vorkath charges up and deals a big magic hit. 
    • Damage is reduced by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492695997513748.png?v=1" alt="superantifire" title="superantifire" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Zonal Ice Breath</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Vorkath takes to the air and spews ice on his location that spreads outward, after which he comes back down. 
    • Can deal three </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hits and one MD </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> slam. 
        • Can be avoided by moving away from Vorkath, also protecting </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1" alt="summoning" title="summoning" kind="icon" /><nowiki> familiars.
    • The </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hits damage Zemouregal and all minions caught within it.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Poison pools</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Vorkath will stand on his hind legs and spew into the air, causing pools that hit hard typeless damage to appear. 
    • Phase 2: Green poison pools, hitting up to 3k.
    • Phase 3: Purple poison pools, hitting up to 5k.
        •  Every hit taken increases Zemouregal's Empowerment debuff by 5%, increasing damage taken.
    • Can be accompanied by the voiceline: </nowiki><strong><code><nowiki>Spew your venom, my malformed pet!</nowiki></code></strong><nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Fly</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Vorkath flies up high to freeze the whole arena by air strike. If not stopped, all in the arena will be hit ~15k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage, killing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1" alt="summoning" title="summoning" kind="icon" /><nowiki> familiars.
    • Using the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968204883603497.png?v=1" alt="balista" title="balista" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (extra action button) while Vorkath is up will shoot Vorkath down, preventing the attack and dealing a 10k hit to Vorkath.
        • Can fail if done right before Vorkath returns!
    • </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used alternatively.
    • Can be accompanied by the voiceline: </nowiki><strong><code><nowiki>Cast my glorious vengeance down upon them!</nowiki></code></strong><nowiki> or </nowiki><strong><code><nowiki>Cut them down without mercy!</nowiki></code></strong><nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Power Meter and Damage Reduction</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ The power meter increases Vorkath's damage dealt by auto attacks as well as mechanics.
⬥ While Vorkath is around, Zemouregal takes no or reduced damage.
    • Every phase transition Zemouregal gets hit 10k by Vorkath, reducing his damage reduction by 10% (100%→90%→80%).
⬥ If Zemouregal gets hit while shielded, a green orb is sent to Vorkath, giving him damage absorption based on the damage dealt on Zemouregal.
    • Vorkath's damage absorption is multiplied by the power meter % and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1" alt="vuln" title="vuln" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Minions</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Zemouregal summons two minions, one of each type.
    • This is a time-based mechanic which resets on phasing.
    • Combat minions (36k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> per player) 
        • Skeleton ranger
        • Zombie warrior
        • Skeleton knight
        • Phantom Spellcaster
    • Support minions (6k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> per player) 
        • Ghost Healer, heals Vorkath 1000 lifepoints.
        • Zombie Shielder, gives Vorkath a shield, reducing incoming damage.
        • Empowering Zombie, adds +50% to the power meter temporarily.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Bone Spikes</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Zemouregal makes a dust cloud appear on  every player's location, where 4.2s later spikes shoot out of the ground.
    • This is a time-based mechanic which resets on phasing.
    • Can deal up to 8k soft typeless damage to every player in the 7x7 area.
    • Can be avoided by moving away from your location.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Soul sap</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Zemouregal uses soul sap </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, gaining one </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Soul Strike</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Zemouregal uses soul strike </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1" alt="soulstrike" title="soulstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, using up one </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and stunning </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> his target for 3 seconds.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Finger of Death</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Zemouregal uses </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, hitting up to 10k through </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941136397324448.png?v=1" alt="protectfromnecro" title="protectfromnecro" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
    • Can be accompanied by the voiceline: </nowiki><strong><code><nowiki>Die!</nowiki></code></strong><nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Death Skulls</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Zemouregal uses </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, hitting up to 7k through </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941136397324448.png?v=1" alt="protectfromnecro" title="protectfromnecro" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Can bounce between players, and also be cancelled by moving more than 6 tiles away.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Blood Siphon</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Zemouregal uses </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1" alt="bloodsiphon" title="bloodsiphon" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Any of his combat minions will run to his side, healing him and increasing the damage dealt on Zemouregal's target.
    • Can be accompanied by the voiceline: </nowiki><strong><code><nowiki>I'll make a feast of your blood, and be strengthened</nowiki></code></strong><nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Volley of Souls</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Zemouregal uses Volley of souls </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hitting up to 3k three times.
    • Is only used in Phase 3.
    • Can only be used when Zemouregal is at 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks.
    • Can be accompanied by the voiceline: </nowiki><strong><code><nowiki>Your life is payment for this folley!</nowiki></code></strong><nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="the-fight"><ins><nowiki>The Fight</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Phase 1 (Vorkath):</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>4 autos → Dragonfire Breath → 4 autos → Zonal ice Breath (+ Bone Spikes and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1" alt="soulstrike" title="soulstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) </nowiki><em><nowiki>Repeat</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Phase 1 (Zemouregal):</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>7 autos (+ minions) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → 1 auto (+ Bone Spikes) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1" alt="soulstrike" title="soulstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><em><nowiki>repeat</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>**Phase 2 (Vorkath):</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><em><em><nowiki>4 autos → Dragonfire Breath → 4 autos → Zonal ice Breath (+ Bone Spikes and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1" alt="soulstrike" title="soulstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) → 4 autos → green poison pools </nowiki></em><nowiki>Repeat</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Phase 2 (Zemouregal):</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>7 autos (+ minions) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → 1 auto (+ Bone Spikes) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1" alt="soulstrike" title="soulstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><em><nowiki>repeat</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Phase 3 (Vorkath):</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>2 autos (</nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> repeated) →</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Fly → 1 auto (+ Bone Spikes) → Dragonfire Breath → 4 autos → Zonal Ice Breath (+ Bone Spikes) → 4 autos → purple poison pools → 4 autos → Dragonfire Breath (+ Bone Spikes) → 4 autos → Zonal Ice Breath → 4 autos → purple poison pools (+ Bone Spikes) → 4 autos </nowiki><em><nowiki>Repeat</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Phase 3 (Zemouregal):</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>8 autos (+ minions) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 1 (+ Bone Spikes) → 6 autos (+ minions) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → 1 auto → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 2 → 1 auto (+ Bone Spikes) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1" alt="bloodsiphon" title="bloodsiphon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (+ minions) → 4 autos → auto + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → 1 auto (+ Bone Spikes) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 3 → 2 autos (+minions) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><em><nowiki>Repeat</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
